notes.title: Dollhouse of Dead - Demo Release
notes.content: [p]A New Horror From the Team Behind Ghost Watchers. We’re thrilled to share that the demo for our next game, [b]Dollhouse of Dead[/b], is now available![/p][p]If you enjoyed the tension and paranormal atmosphere of Ghost Watchers, you’ll feel right at home in the haunted halls of the dollhouse — but this time, the terror takes a new form. Step into the dollhouse today and be among the first to experience our new vision of fear[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3983110/Dollhouse_of_Dead_Demo/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Hungry Ghost Festival
notes.content: [p]Ghost Watchers Joins the Hungry Ghost Festival[/p][p][/p][p]We’re thrilled to share that Ghost Watchers will take part in the upcoming Hungry Ghost Festival—a cultural event deeply rooted in Asian traditions, where spirits are honored and the boundary between the living and the dead grows thin[/p][p][/p][p]With 18% of our players coming from Asia, this feels like the perfect occasion to celebrate together. The Hungry Ghost Festival is not just about fear—it’s about respect for the unseen, and we’re honored to bring Ghost Watchers into this atmosphere of mystery and reverence[/p][p][/p][p]Expect haunting encounters, eerie thrills, and perhaps a few surprises prepared just for the festival[/p][p]To our Asian community—and all ghost hunters worldwide—thank you for being part of this journey. See you at the festival![/p]

notes.title: IRONSAND - Demo READY
notes.content: [p]We are pleased to present our new project, the cooperative roguelike shooter IRONSAND[/p][p]Epic battles, cute long-eared companions, and gigantic combat robots await you! You can try out the [b]demo version[/b] of the game now[/p][p][/p][p][b]We look forward to your feedback. Enjoy the game![/b][/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2454600/Ironsand/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41657964/4191bfd44a88f5557ea8653f6cf8515b2992bbe9.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41657964/73ca736811fb8687a3b929a89d790538b167d6c6.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41657964/973839f490d2304f8366dca9b598b7f900deb694.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Dollhouse of Dead - Playtest
notes.content: [p]A couple of days ago, we launched an open playtest for our new game - Dollhouse of Dead. You will play as scavangers who sneak into abandoned factories filled with scary toys[/p][p][b]We would love for you to participate in the playtest and look forward to your feedback![/b][/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2977810/Dollhouse_of_Dead/?utm_source=cross"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Full Release
notes.content: [p]We are pleased to present you a major update of the game, marking the release of the game in full access! We have added a lot of new things![/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for being with us all this time! Since its Early Access debut, Ghost Watchers has captivated players with its immersive atmosphere, dynamic ghost behaviors and lots of funny moments (and bugs, ofc!). This update represents months of polish, new features, and scares that will test even the bravest ghost hunters[/p][p][/p][p][b]In this update, you will find:[/b][/p][list][*][p]New map - Cemetery Forest[/p][/*][*][p]New Ghosts - The Yellow King and the Witch[/p][/*][*][p]New items[/p][/*][*][p]Added tutorial[/p][/*][*][p]Added mini games[/p][/*][*][p]Rebalance and fixes of ghost behaviors and their features[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bugs in mind stealing[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bugs with items[/p][/*][*][p]and much more![/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41657964/a6a17879dcb82a892732033a0f03aa09d3a57441.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41657964/bfdc5c4efe72cedcb24e9852a4044e6fc68c6645.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41657964/6cc5061ffe9fef417b31e40d1d3ef71c1ede6494.png"][/img][/p]

[h2]New mechanics for ghosts reaction[/h2]

Now when players scare the ghost away, it takes a protective object in his hands and examines it. Meanwhile, players should run away from the ghost for a certain distance in order not to fall under his next attack. If players do not run away to the right distance, attacks continue continuously until the death of the players

This distance depends on the subject, the ghost and the difficulty level. An alarm sound warns you about this distance

notes.title: February'23 Update
notes.content:
We are glad to present you a major update of the game, in which you may find a large-scale change in the behavior of ghosts. Thank you for being with us all this time! In this update, you will find:
[list]
[*] Ghosts now hide in the rooms. They need to be searched for to get evidence.
[*] Ghosts now have a special hunt, during which they become invulnerable. You need to run away from them and hide. Hiding won't come out at an insane level of difficulty.
[*] The ghosts received a unique condition for each of their age and mood.
[*] Also, the insane difficulty becomes really INSANE! Now the usual EMP, thermometer and notepad do not work here. Instead, new evidence is emerging.
[*] New map - Swamp House
[*] New ghost - Kuchisake Onna
[*] Added a modifier - High Rank.
[*] The new item is an adrenaline syringe. Allows you to run fast, which helps you with deadly hunting.
[*] Redesigned sounds in the game
[/list]

The game becomes more difficult, and the mechanics are deeper, so the total reward for passing increases.

More information about the new game mechanics can be found in the video on the Steam page and read in the "How to play" section in the Tablet and the game menu

notes.title: Huge October UPDATE

•	Added a new evidence to identify the ghost
•	Updated some sounds
•	Redesign of locations (Abandoned House, School, Police Station)

[b]FIXES[/b]

•	Fixed bugs with collision on locations

•	Fixed the display of traces
•	Fixed bugs with the behavior of ghosts
•	Fixed spawn of items in the van

•	Fixed a bug with the inability to take a picture of the traces of blood

notes.title: Developers Broadcast
notes.content:
[h1]HOW TO PLAY[/h1]


Ghost Watchers is totally about haunting evil spirits. The process of haut consists of 3 stages:[list]
[*]Determine the special properties of the ghost
[*]Perform the right weakening ritual
[*]Catch a ghost using special trap
[/list]
 
Special ghost properties: Type, Age and Mood. Each property can be determined using special tools


[h2]How to catch a ghost[/h2]

You need to complete all the tasks from the weakening list in the correct order. If you have done 3 tasks correctly, but the 4th one is wrong, you do not need to start from the beginning

At a normal level of difficulty, you can understand that the correct action has been done by the message that appears at the top of the screen and the special sound. On hard and insane - only by the special sound

If you have done all the actions correctly, then the ghost will walk around the house in a visible state. Throw the catcher at the ghost

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41657964/ace698722b4f95516cd5a94f8dba4fa8e62250aa.jpg[/img]
 

[h2]Pad[/h2]
 
To collect evidence and read hints, use <TAB>. You will see a pad, in the left part of which you need to indicate the collected evidence. In the right part you need to select the correct properties of the ghost. The selected evidence from the left part will help to select the propreties in the right part. There are two buttons at the bottom of the pad:[list]
[*]Encyclopedia. This section contains descriptions of all the ghosts and tools
[*]Weakening the ghost. This section provides a list of actions to weaken the ghost. In the right part there is a hint on the action of the tools on the selected type of ghost
 [/list]
Each correct action to weaken the ghost will be accompanied by the sound of a gong and a hint (at an normal difficulty level). If you perform actions in the correct sequence, but do not see these effects - most likely, you made a mistake with the properties of the ghost. Check it again!
 
There are also some additional quests that gives you coins. Coins can be immediately spent on the purchase of tools. Purchased tools are not transferred to the next session

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41657964/0a7de3123c427114a897b4c6d89d6a561dc3f3d6.jpg[/img]
 

[h2]Difficulties[/h2]
 
We recommend you to start from the normal difficulty. You may see hints on this difficulty

On the hard difficulty:[list]
[*]You lose your tools when the ghost takes you away
[*]The ghost can lock the front door at the moment of attack
 [/list]
On the insane difficulty:[list]
[*]The ghost can break electric tools in your hands
[*]Ghost can attack hunters outside the house
[*]Many items have got only one charge
[/list]

[h2]Types of protective items[/h2]

The ones that need to be thrown:[list]
[*]Different types of salt
[*]Different types of bombs
[*]Holy water
[*]Holy fire
[/list]
The ones that need to be put on the floor:[list]
[*]Plasma Absorber
[*]Withering Light
[/list]
The ones you need to hold in your hands:[list]
[*]Cross
[*]Christ
[*]Incense
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41657964/8d57def6d95867a2ce5fca6cf6e396082c00eca1.jpg[/img]


[h2]Gameplay after death[/h2]

After death, you do not completely leave the game, but remain as a spirit. You can interact with doors, switches, valves and candles. You are able to communicate with alive players in this way or scare your friends!


[h2]Ghost Materialization[/h2]
 
 
Before you begin the ritual of weakening the ghost, you need to materialize it. To do this, there is a special device for materialization near the van. It is necessary to correctly determine the parameters of the ghost and load them into the Device for the materialization of ghosts, and then start the Device. If the parameters are determined correctly, the ghost will take its finished form and it can be weakened. If players launch the Device with incorrect parameters several times, they lose the game
 
 
[h2]The "Ectoplasm collection" modifier[/h2]
 
 
Players have to collect three ghost ectoplasms to get a Ghost Trap. Two ectoplasmas will be hidden on the level. The last one falls from the ghost when it is scared away. Ectoplasm of different types of ghosts becomes visible with the help of different tools: UV flashlight, holy fire or camera. Refer to the Tab for a hint

 
 
[h2]The "Sanity" Modifier[/h2]
 
 
Players are given a new characteristic - sanity. You can lose your sanity at ghostly events and go mad. If your mental health has dropped to 0, then the ghost protection may not work and you may die. Maintain sanity at the right level with the help of special pills.
 
 
[h2]The "Pentagram" modifier
[/h2] 
 
Players will have to collect various items at the location for the pentagram ritual. Before the capture, it is necessary to perform a ritual. You must throw a ritual dagger into the pentagram to activate the ritual and summon the ghost. Manage to insert the necessary items into every corner, thereby preventing the ghost from getting out. Beware of the circle of the ghost's attack, so as not to be attacked.
